subject: Access entitlement clean-up + SCIM/SAML evidence request
messages:
From: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@clarityhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:14:00Z
Subject: Evidence request: SCIM delta + SAML assertions for procurement

Hi Marcus,

We're moving through Clarity's procurement and security review for Redwood. Our InfoSec team asked for a short bundle of artifacts so they can close out the SIG/CAIQ items:

- SAML metadata (IdP/ACS endpoints, cert thumbprint, signing/encryption algs)
- SCIM sync logs (delta events) for the last 30 days showing adds/patches/deletes
- RBAC role mapping for service accounts & recommended least-privilege mappings
- A statement of support for SAML 2.0 + details on IdP-initiated login behavior
- Any audit/log locations for user provisioning and account changes (where we can pull logs)

Can you get us these by EOD 2027-04-18? If that's aggressive, a partial delivery by 2027-04-14 would be very helpful. Reference: SIG-3482 in our questionnaire.

Also — if you can provide a short test account list we can use to validate IdP->SP flows that would speed the review.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Barnes
Security Engineer, Clarity Health
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SCIM delta + SAML assertions for procurement

Alex — thanks for the clear list.

Quick plan and owners so you know who's collecting what:
- Neha will collect SAML metadata, ACS/audience details and provide a small set of IdP-initiated/SP-initiated test steps + test users (neha.kapoor@redwood.com).
- Priyom will export SCIM delta logs and a human-readable sync report (cc'd via follow-up).
- Laura will provide RBAC mappings and our role-pruning plan (which covers least-privilege recommendations).

Target: partial deliverable by 2027-04-14 (SAML metadata + sample test accounts + high-level RBAC mapping). Full SCIM delta export and detailed role matrix by 2027-04-18. If Clarity needs anything earlier, tell us which items are highest priority and we'll accelerate.

Also: can you confirm whether Clarity wants redwood-hosted logs or a temporary secure transfer (SFTP/Drive/NDA)?

I'll route the request internally now.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Customer Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@clarityhealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T11:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SCIM delta + SAML assertions for procurement

Alex / Marcus — attaching SAML metadata and a small CSV of two test accounts for IdP->SP validation. See attachments: redwood_saml_metadata.xml, sso-test-accounts.csv.

Summary (high level):
- Protocol: SAML 2.0 (SP-initiated and IdP-initiated supported).
- Assertion: Signed assertions; optional encryption supported. Audience restriction and Recipient (ACS) validated on our side.
- Signatures: SHA256 with RSA keys; current cert thumbprint included in the metadata file.
- NameID formats: persistent and emailAddress supported; we recommend persistent for service accounts.

How to validate quickly:
1) Configure Clarity IdP to point to our metadata (attached).
2) Use the two test accounts in sso-test-accounts.csv for one IdP-initiated and one SP-initiated sign-in.
3) If you want, we can run a short demo (15 min) to observe assertions together.

Links: https://docs.redwood.com/integrations/saml#quickstart (internal docs)

Let me know if you need the raw assertion logs (SAML request/response XML). We retain them for 90 days and can export specific assertion traces upon request.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
IAM & Integrations Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@clarityhealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-13T15:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SCIM delta + SAML assertions for procurement

Alex — attached is our role mapping workbook and a short role-pruning plan (role-mapping-and-pruning-20270413.xlsx). TL;DR:

- Role model: coarse-grained project roles (viewer/editor/admin) + service-account scoped roles for automated systems.
- Least-privilege guidance: start with viewer-only for new integrations and escalate only where write/delete is required.
- Pruning: roles that have not been assigned or used in 180+ days will be flagged for review; we plan an initial prune candidate list next month — we can share that list for Clarity to validate before any removal.
- Audit trails: role changes are recorded in our provisioning audit log (retained 365 days). You can request CSV exports for any account or time window.

If Clarity has existing mappings (e.g., 'Clarity-ServiceAccount' with specific entitlements), share them and we'll produce a one-to-one recommended mapping.

A couple of notes on timing: pruning is a controlled process — we don't delete anything without owner signoff. The deliverable attached includes column-level notes for each role explaining required justification.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@clarityhealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SCIM delta + SAML assertions for procurement

Alex — attaching the SCIM delta export and a small human-readable sync report: scim-delta-20270314-20270413.csv, scim-sync-report-20270414.html. Notes:

- SCIM spec: v2.0, supports bulk and incremental (delta) pulls via changeToken/paging.
- The CSV contains event_type (CREATE, PATCH, DELETE), timestamp (UTC), user_id, external_id, change_details (JSON string) — we redact full PII when exporting customer reports; full sync records are available under a data access agreement.
- Last full successful sync to Clarity's tenant: 2027-04-10T02:12:34Z. The delta export covers 2027-03-14 to 2027-04-13 inclusive.
- Example PATCH operation recorded in the change_details column: {"operations": [{"op":"Replace","path":"emails[primary]","value":"masked@example.com"}]}

If you need a narrower time slice or a different format (NDJSON, JSONL), tell us and we will regenerate.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Platform Integrations Engineer
Redwood Inference
